$comment: Canonical type-rule table (issue 003). Types are deterministic where the domain IS the type; everything else falls to the model's guess (see tagging-prompt.md) with human veto in the UI (issue 006). Precedence: manual > rule > ai. These rules must be mirrored in Karakeep's rule engine (Settings -> Rule Engine) — one rule per uiContains string: WHEN bookmark is added, IF URL contains <uiContains>, THEN add tag <type/...>. The smoke script uses `hosts` for exact-hostname matching; `uiContains` strings are substring-safe forms for Karakeep's 'URL contains' condition (bare 'x.com' would match spacex.com).
